name: Information Architecture and Navigation Model
description: Design the cockpit information architecture, navigation model, and progressive disclosure strategy. This mission covers the structural organization of the Tribunus cockpit: hierarchy of views, command palette integration, keyboard navigation, agent activity panels, authority/approval UX, and progressive disclosure of complexity for new users.
purpose: Define the information architecture that organizes the cockpit's views, commands, and agent interactions into a coherent navigation model. Progressive disclosure ensures novices aren't overwhelmed while power users retain rapid access to deep functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: IA diagram documents the cockpit view hierarchy, nested navigation paths, and cross-view relationships
Navigation specification defines command palette, keyboard shortcuts, breadcrumb trail, and persistent navigation chrome
Progressive disclosure strategy describes tiered feature revelations for novice/intermediate/expert users
Agent activity visualization and authority approval UX flows are documented in the navigation model
Recovery UX and failure state patterns are mapped within the navigation structure
